title: Vieta-pin makes COUNT face a power-sum-Newton image (F3<->F5 bridge): the bridge identity is PROVEN exactly, but it relabels lacBad into the Lam-Leung antipodal additive-energy count (welds to W-LamLeung)
evidence: Three exact-integer probes at PROPER dyadic subgroups mu_n<F_q^* (n=8,16,32; q prime =1 mod n, q~n^4, n<<sqrt q). (1) scripts/probes/_407_conn/C036_newton_powersum_bridge.py: the Newton-identity bridge is verified EXACT in char p -- {S subset mu_n,|S|=a, e_1=...=e_{t-1}=0} == {p_1=...=p_{t-1}=0} (all rows 'EQUIV', identical count AND identical e_t-image set) and p_t=(-1)^{t-1} t e_t holds exactly (all 'p_t=ID-OK'), for every (a,t) with a<=6, all three n. So the C036 claim 'lacBad = a vanishing-power-sum subset count, char-sum-free' is a TRUE, q-independent, decidable identity. lacBad is also confirmed coset-closed under mult by g^t (the in-tree lacBad_smul_closed). (2) C036_wall_weld.py: with a faithful large-prime char-0 proxy vs a prize-scale prime, char-0 count == char-p count EXACTLY for all tested params (zero spurious char-p mass at these sizes) -- the bridge faithfully reproduces the char-0 object; the char-p transfer at r~ln q is the SAME open piece as #389. The count is energy-scale, not O(n): at n=32 a=4 t=2 it is 120, a=6 t=2 it is 560. (3) C036_antipodal_identity.py: the t=2 (sum-zero a-subset) count equals C(n/2, a/2) EXACTLY (n=8:4/6/4; n=16:8/28/56; n=32:16/120/560) -- i.e. the vanishing-power-sum count is LITERALLY the Lam-Leung antipodal-pairing count (a sum-zero subset of 2-power roots = disjoint union of a/2 negation pairs), the exact object EnergyRelationAntipodal.energy_relation_count_antipodal governs. Window-interior decay confirmed (n=32 a=8: t=2->1820, t=3->28, t=4->28, t>=5->4): deep window is small, crossover band ~n is where it is nontrivial.
reduced_to: The Newton bridge sharpens the open floor to: bound the simultaneous-vanishing-power-sum subset count #{S subset mu_{2^mu}: |S|=a, p_1(S)=...=p_{t-1}(S)=0} by O(n) at the window-interior/crossover gap, for prize-scale n=2^30, q~n*2^128. This is EXACTLY the Lam-Leung deep-moment antipodal-energy rigidity (= the char-p transfer of E_r(mu_n)<=(2r-1)!! n^r to r~ln q). It does NOT give an independent handle: the object IS the additive energy E_{t-1}(mu_n) the wall already controls in char 0, just reached via Newton's identities instead of char sums.
wall: W-LamLeung (= the deep-moment / antipodal additive-energy rigidity, faces 3<->4 of the open core; the char-p transfer of E_r(mu_n) to r~ln q, i.e. the BGK sqrt-cancellation wall). The char-sum-free route reaches the same wall by a different door.
honest_note: The PROVEN part is real and clean: the F3<->F5 bridge is an exact, q-independent, decidable identity (Newton e_t<->p_t on the vanishing variety), verified at multiple proper dyadic subgroups, and it correctly identifies lacBad with the vanishing-power-sum/energy count. What is NOT shown -- and is the whole prize -- is the O(n) floor on that count at prize scale; numerics confirm the count is energy-scale (binomial C(n/2,a/2)-type), not O(n), in the small-gap regime, and the file already excludes that regime. The bridge is a relabeling that welds the COUNT face onto the SAME Lam-Leung/BGK wall (confirmed by exact char-0==char-p agreement), not a closure. No counterexample to the floor was found (the t>=t0 window-interior counts do shrink toward ~n); this is NOT a refutation. Probes use a<=6-8 brute force; not run at n=64/prize n=2^30 (infeasible), but the antipodal identity C(n/2,a/2) is an exact closed form that extrapolates the structure. Should be cited alongside C031/C032 as another face that reduces to W-LamLeung.
